description: Defines the QpackDecodedHeadersAccumulator class, which manages decoding of headers in the QPACK protocol, including handling success and error callbacks, and tracking header sizes.

classes.name: QpackDecodedHeadersAccumulator
classes.description: Manages the decoding process of headers, tracks sizes, and communicates success or errors via the Visitor interface.

classes.name: QpackDecodedHeadersAccumulator::Visitor
classes.description: Interface for callback methods to signal success or error in header decoding.

methods.name: QpackDecodedHeadersAccumulator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the accumulator with stream ID, decoder, visitor, and size limit.

methods.name: OnHeaderDecoded
methods.description: Handles a decoded header name and value.

methods.name: OnDecodingCompleted
methods.description: Signals that header decoding is complete.

methods.name: OnDecodingErrorDetected
methods.description: Handles an error detected during decoding.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Feeds data into the decoder for processing.

methods.name: EndHeaderBlock
methods.description: Signals the end of a header block.
